reviews.x: I wasn’t going to keep this because it looked too opaque, but when I went to return it, Amazon just told me to keep it. So I figured I would try it out and if I didn’t like it I would give it to my sister. I’m glad I tried it, this is my new favorite! Perfect natural looking nails. I’ll be ordering more when I run out.

I loved using this gel polish, it was the perfect thickness and color I wanted. Keep in mind that I did have dip powder underneath the gel so the white milky color is more adamant than it would be on regular nails without a dip base. I’m not the best with gel but this was awesome to work with!

This photo was taken after a week and a half of having it on my nails. The gold that I used had started to wear off the tips of my nails but the milky white polish didn't budge! I really did my nails with just the white and stickers and I'm on week three with no chips or peeling. The key I've found is to lightly buff my nails and make sure there's no dust before applying a base coat and then I have been using 4 thin coats of the FANZEST polish to get a slightly more opaque look along with a top

reviews.t: The only sheer polish I found that stays ON BABY
reviews.x: I ordered the “milky white” gel polish and I really love it! I do landscaping and gardening so my hands and nails get trashed. I applied a base coat, three coats of the milky white gel polish, and then finished with a top coat. I saw some reviews complaining that the gel polish peeled off so I’m guessing they didn’t use a base coat because this baby stayed on through thick and thin for a week.

Very disappointed— it doesn’t get hardened. I tried on last night, two coats, enough length of UV light each time, still very soft and easily peel off. It was very shiny and pretty when I applied, next morning it looked dull already and started peeling. Also color 03 is too white, next one is too pink. I’m going back to Korean gel nail stickers.

Beautiful.  Cured quickly with the UV light.  I just put a coat of clear hardener over it.  This is color "03" and one full coat.  The only downfall is after a few days of washing your hands,  they begin to peel.  The plus side to this is it's easy to take off and try a new color.  Personally,  doing my nails is almost therapeutic,  so it's not so bad.

Exactly Wht I was looking for I hope they come out with more of these types of sheer but pigmented jelly colors this is 3 coats 🥰 I see so many negative reviews u need to add a base and top coat use correctly and it’s phenomenal 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼
Pretty milky color. Depending how many coats you use, you can adjust how sheer it is. East and clean application. Great price. I did about three light coats to get the color in these pictures.

This color is perfection, didn’t think it would be such great quality for the price. But I was wrong. Would definitely buy again!! Look at the color, I did 3 layers for all the nails and only one layer for the middle finger with specs of gold. And they look perfect. The polish is thick, which is why I did 3 light layers. If you over do it it will most likely look bulky so be careful. Purchased mainly for my press on nails business stylish glam nails.

MUCH more sheer than I thought it would be, since I was expecting the opaque milky white color in the photos. This pic is after 5 coats on natural nails. The first coat was so translucent it was difficult to tell it was there, but it sort of evened the tone of my nails. Almost like a tinted moisturizer may even your skin tone but you still see everything, if that makes sense

I LOVE this. It's literally the exact milky white I was trying to find. It goes on nice and smooth so even if you choose to do 4 or 5 coats it still looks perfect. I got tons of compliments and this is my go-to color now. I just ordered my second bottle. I am really impressed with the quality for this price.

I knew that I would have to do many layers, which was fine. I wanted a somewhat sheer and pinky look. However, it started to peel in a couple days. I tried it a second time with longer cure time and it still peeled, so I ended up returning.

i ordered a very sheer natural pink color and got a white instead. very sad because it took a while to get here and cost $7.50. the bottle itself looks really pretty though.. but still upset about the mix up. not rlly worth it

reviews.t: Great gel polish, light and sheer
reviews.x: I used the pink and white from Fanzest and love them both.  Pretty sheer so they take 2-4 coats but I looks so much more natural than the salon airbrush!  I love it.

reviews.t: 301 Good for price. Easy to use.
reviews.x: Two layers on natural nails of color 301. Sheer warm nude. If you're looking for something with more of a hint of pink I would not get this one.
I was looking for a sheer pink but this looks more like white out
These sheer/ nude colors are my new go to.

Purchased both 'Milky White' and 'Sheer Pink':  "Milky White" (3/5 stars) layers come out streaky, so I had to do 5 layers and file down. I wanted to do very thin & light base layer, but unable to achieve that with this gel polish. But I don't mind the jelly-like look of 5 layers of the Milky White gel, so I'll continue to use it.  "Sheer Pink" (5/5 stars). 1 layer is enough to have your nail be beautifully sheer nude/pink. I wanted it to be more pinkish, so I put on 3 layers.  Averaged out the

[[VIDEOID:b987e5bd2eaca868a56c0cb5bc288f48]] I use 4 coats to get this colour. I really like the natural effect. It’s not white. It’s like milky white as indicated. It’s was thick but not too thick like hard. It was sheer though thick. I used more coats for my complexion and as you see I wanted to do a lil design as it’s Christmas.  My steps were dehydrator, primer, base, colour, top so I believe it will last well.

I have tried the solid white gel polish but I really wanted something that I could work with for an ombre  french tip look. Whether you work it to the french tip look or brush the whole nail...this is beautiful. First coat is translucent, second cost semi-transparent and if you go third, it is a milky white. Fast shipping!

Maybe there is a learning curve, but this came out pretty streaky. Settled heavier in some areas than others. Milky white color. Pictures attached show what I mean. Hopefully 2nd time I apply it will be less streaky if I run the bottle under hot water.

This was one coat. The coverage is inconsistent. I have close to 40 gel polishes and this one is the only one with lint and tiny hairs in it. My usual milky while gel polish was out of stock so I got this one because of the positive reviews.

It's perfect! Much better than another bottle I bought. Two coats and it's beautiful! This pic is over white fake nails, but I tried on my natural nails and it was just a little more sheer, but covered perfectly (no streaks/unevenness)!

I got the milky white color.  I love it, I’ve been searching for a sheer white nail polish like this, it’s exactly what I wanted.  And not that it matters but the packaging and bottle were also really pretty.
This is not very sheer, more like thin. It also has globs of white randomly in the polish. I am not a fan. There are much better products out there. I was just looking for a milky white gel polish.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the milky white color and find it natural-looking and high quality for the price.
Several reviewers note the polish is sheer and requires multiple coats (often 2-5) to build up the desired color.
Some reviewers report the polish peeling off after a few days despite proper application and curing.
A few reviewers say the polish did not harden or cure properly under the UV light.
Some reviewers mention receiving the wrong color or finding the shade different from expected.
